reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, UPPER(TRIM(sku)) AS clean_sku
FROM products
WHERE sku LIKE 'vm%'
alternatives: SELECT product_id, UPPER(REPLACE(sku, ' ', '')) AS clean_sku FROM products WHERE sku LIKE 'vm%'
SELECT product_id, TRIM(UPPER(sku)) AS clean_sku FROM products WHERE sku LIKE 'vm%'

other_way.sql: SELECT product_id, UPPER(REPLACE(sku, ' ', '')) AS clean_sku FROM products WHERE sku LIKE 'vm%'
other_way.tradeoff: REPLACE drops every space, inside the sku too, while TRIM keeps inner spaces, so pick the one the standard form asks for.
